sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm David Marchese.
sentences.zh: 我是大卫·马尔凯塞。

sentences.en: Bob Odenkirk has had one of show business's most wonderfully improbable careers.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·奥登科克拥有演艺界最不可思议、最精彩的职业生涯之一。

sentences.en: After decades as a cult hero in the comedy world, thanks mostly to his 90s sketch series Mr. Show with Bob and David,
sentences.zh: 在喜剧界作为邪典英雄度过几十年后，这主要归功于他在90年代的素描喜剧系列《鲍勃和大卫秀》，

sentences.en: he became a mainstream success as, of all things, a serious dramatic actor.
sentences.zh: 他竟然转型成为了一名严肃的剧情片演员，并在主流获得了成功。

sentences.en: First in a supporting part as the shifty lawyer Saul Goodman on Breaking Bad, and then to further acclaim as the star of that show's spinoff Better Call Saul.
sentences.zh: 起初是在《绝命毒师》中饰演狡猾的律师索尔·古德曼这一配角，随后因主演该剧的衍生剧《风骚律师》而获得更多赞誉。

sentences.en: Lately, his career has taken another turn that few could have seen coming, to action movie star.
sentences.zh: 最近，他的职业生涯迎来了另一个鲜有人预料到的转向：动作片明星。

sentences.en: The latest example is called Normal.
sentences.zh: 最新的作品名叫《正常》。

sentences.en: In it, Odenkirk plays a small-town Minnesota sheriff facing off against, among other villains, the Yakuza.
sentences.zh: 在片中，奥登科克饰演明尼苏达州一个小镇的警长，要与包括极道在内的各路反派正面交锋。

sentences.en: You might think that at 63 years old,
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得，在63岁这个年纪，

sentences.en: Odenkirk would be pretty pleased with the way his career and life have shaken out.
sentences.zh: 奥登科克对自己职业生涯和生活的现状应该会相当满意。

sentences.en: But you'd be wrong.
sentences.zh: 但你猜错了。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Bob Odenkirk.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与鲍勃·奥登科克的对话。

sentences.en: Bob, I think we're good to go if you're good to go.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃，如果你准备好了，我觉得我们随时可以开始。

sentences.en: This is a big production, as I said to you.
sentences.zh: 正如我刚才对你说的，这是一次大制作。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: We were just sitting down.
sentences.zh: 我们刚坐下。

sentences.en: It just feels very important in a way that scares the shit out of me.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉极其重要，重要到让我吓得要死。

sentences.en: But onwards.
sentences.zh: 但还是继续吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I don't want you to be scared.
sentences.zh: 我可不想让你害怕。

sentences.en: There's nothing to be scared of.
sentences.zh: 没什么好害怕的。

sentences.en: It's all in your head.
sentences.zh: 这都是你脑子里的想法。

sentences.en: There's nothing bad that's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 不会发生什么不好的事的。

sentences.en: Oh, there's a lot in my head, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，我脑子里确实有很多想法，是的。

sentences.en: All the bad stuff.
sentences.zh: 全都是不好的事。

sentences.en: But thank you again for being here.
sentences.zh: 但还是再次感谢你能来到这里。

sentences.en: And just before I was told that we got the green light to start, you were telling me about a novel you just read.
sentences.zh: 就在我被告知可以开始录制之前，你跟我聊起你刚读的一本小说。

sentences.en: And how it affected your thinking maybe about something important that happened to you.
sentences.zh: 以及它如何影响你对发生在你身上某件重要事情的看法。

sentences.en: So pick up where you left off.
sentences.zh: 所以，接着刚才的话题继续聊吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So almost four years ago, I had this heart incident.
sentences.zh: 差不多四年以前，我经历了一次心脏危机。

sentences.en: One of the tributaries to my Widowmaker artery was shut down completely by a plaque buildup.
sentences.zh: 我的一根“寡妇制造者”动脉的分支被斑块完全堵塞了。

sentences.en: And I was really out.
sentences.zh: 当时我真的不省人事了。

sentences.en: And I went to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 然后我去了医院。

sentences.en: I got two stents.
sentences.zh: 我装了两个支架。

sentences.en: I really went down on the set of Better Call Saul.
sentences.zh: 我真的是在《风骚律师》的片场倒下的。

sentences.en: And it was really scary, especially for everyone around me.
sentences.zh: 这真的很吓人，尤其是对我周围的每个人来说。

sentences.en: Not for me, because I don't have any memory of it.
sentences.zh: 对我而言倒不算，因为我对此完全没有记忆。

sentences.en: But I've talked about it many times.
sentences.zh: 不过我跟人谈起过很多次。

sentences.en: And people have asked me many times, how did that affect you?
sentences.zh: 人们也问过我很多次，那次经历对你有什么影响？

sentences.en: And I think first people want to hear that you saw a white light.
sentences.zh: 我想大家首先都希望能听到你看到了白光。

sentences.en: Then they would love to hear that you watched your whole life pass before you on a film reel.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会很乐意听到你看到自己的一生像电影胶片一样在眼前闪过。

sentences.en: And I kind of wish that happened to me.
sentences.zh: 我甚至有点希望这事发生在我身上。

sentences.en: That would have been cool.
sentences.zh: 那一定很酷。

sentences.en: But that didn't happen to me.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有发生在我身上。

sentences.en: It was a blank for me for a week.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那有一周时间是空白的。

sentences.en: I came to essentially a week later.
sentences.zh: 基本上是一周后我才恢复意识。

sentences.en: I came to the next day.
sentences.zh: 我第二天就醒过来了。

sentences.en: But I don't have any memories until a week later.
sentences.zh: 但我直到一周后才有记忆。

sentences.en: So I've tried to answer this question to people.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直试图向人们回答这个问题。

sentences.en: How did it impact you?
sentences.zh: 它对你有什么冲击？

sentences.en: And I've had a hard time doing it.
sentences.zh: 但我很难把它讲清楚。

sentences.en: Because I've always felt I don't do justice to the feeling of it, the experience of it.
sentences.zh: 因为我总觉得我没有表达出那种感觉、那种体验的真谛。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So then I'm reading this book, that novel that's called On the Calculation of Volume.
sentences.zh: 然后我正在读这本书，那本名叫《论体积的计算》的小说。

sentences.en: And I'm reading this book.
sentences.zh: 我正在读这本书。

sentences.en: And the character in this book is having a very unique experience of time.
sentences.zh: 书中的角色对时间有着非常独特的体验。

sentences.en: And she's relating her experience of reliving the same day over and over.
sentences.zh: 她在讲述自己不断经历同一天的体验。

sentences.en: And I come to these passages, and I'm like, that's how I felt.
sentences.zh: 当我读到这些段落时，我想，这就是我的感觉。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: That's exactly how I felt for weeks after having this heart attack.
sentences.zh: 这正是我心脏病发作后几个星期里的真实感受。

sentences.en: And I could—there's like a couple passages in here that I marked because I'm like, I've never been able to express this to people.
sentences.zh: 我能——这里有几个段落我做了记号，因为我想，我从来没能向人们表达过这种感受。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Can you read one?
sentences.zh: 你能读一段吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'll read you a section to show you what I mean.
sentences.zh: 我读一段给你听，让你明白我的意思。

sentences.en: And she says that in this unfathomable vastness, these infinitesimal elements are still able to hold themselves together.
sentences.zh: 她说，在这不可测的浩瀚之中，这些微不足道的元素依然能够凝聚在一起。

sentences.en: She's talking about the world around us and ourselves.
sentences.zh: 她是在谈论我们周围的世界和我们自己。

sentences.en: That we manage to stay afloat.
sentences.zh: 我们设法维持浮沉。

sentences.en: That we exist at all.
sentences.zh: 我们居然能够存在。

sentences.en: That each of us has come into being as only one of untold possibilities.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人作为无数可能性中的唯一一个而诞生。

sentences.en: She goes on like that.
sentences.zh: 她接着就是这样写的。

sentences.en: And I marked that whole passage.
sentences.zh: 我给整段都做了记号。

sentences.en: But then later, and I'll just read this one section.
sentences.zh: 但后来，我只读这一小节。

sentences.en: I had a day to go, and I went with it.
sentences.zh: 我还有一天的时间，而我顺其自然地度过了。

sentences.en: There was no plan.
sentences.zh: 没有任何计划。

sentences.en: There was an outline, one which I could follow, floating gently.
sentences.zh: 有一个大纲，一个我可以遵循、轻轻漂浮的大纲。

sentences.en: There was no goal, no prey to be caught.
sentences.zh: 没有目标，也没有要捕获的猎物。

sentences.en: I was not a circling raptor, a vulture, a shark, a big cat poised to spring.
sentences.zh: 我不是盘旋的猛禽、秃鹫、鲨鱼，也不是蓄势待发的大型猫科动物。

sentences.en: I was not on my guard.
sentences.zh: 我没有戒备。

sentences.en: This was something else.
sentences.zh: 这是完全不同的体验。

sentences.en: I was on a journey on my way home, I thought.
sentences.zh: 我想，我是在一段回家的旅程中。

sentences.en: I was traveling on an open ticket with no itinerary.
sentences.zh: 我拿着一张没有具体行程表的通票在旅行。

sentences.en: I journeyed through the minutiae of the streets in a universe replete with minor incidents, a host of objects and occurrences and sensations all crowded together in my memory.
sentences.zh: 我在街道的细枝末节中穿行，身处一个充满微小事件、无数物体、遭遇和感官体验的宇宙中，这一切都在我的记忆中摩肩接踵。

sentences.en: Well, there's a few more passages, but gosh, to hit upon that and think, that's what I should tell people.
sentences.zh: 好吧，还有好几个段落，但是天哪，读到这里时我想，这正是我应该告诉大家的。

sentences.en: I just couldn't believe how much these couple passages expressed this way of living that had something to do with experiencing time,
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信，这几段话竟能如此贴切地表达出一种生活方式，这种方式与体验时间有关，

sentences.en: obviously this term being present, but it took no effort, and how amazing it was.
sentences.zh: 显然这个词就是“活在当下”，但这毫不费力，而且是多么奇妙。

sentences.en: It was really a beautiful way to live in the world, and I knew it would go away, too.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一种美好的世俗生活方式，而且我也知道它终究会消失。

sentences.en: This is going to go away a little at a time as I go forward, and I have to try to remember it.
sentences.zh: 随着我继续前行，这种感觉会一点一点消失，我必须努力去记住它。

sentences.en: I have to try to live this way.
sentences.zh: 我必须努力这样生活。

sentences.en: I just—the degree of freshness to the world around me and the amazement of that and the beauty of it was something I got to be in.
sentences.zh: 我只是——我周围的世界那种崭新的程度、那种惊叹之感以及它的美丽，是我有幸亲身经历的。

sentences.en: And so I thought that might come up, that question, and since I just happened upon these passages, I wanted to share them.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这个问题可能会被问到，既然我刚刚偶然读到这些段落，我很想分享它们。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was going to come up, but something else I was interested in about that experience is related to what you just described,
sentences.zh: 是的，这个问题本来就会被问到，但我对那种经历感兴趣的另一个方面与你刚才描述的有关，

sentences.en: the awareness that that feeling of being present was going to fade.
sentences.zh: 那种意识到这种活在当下的感觉将会消逝的觉知。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How effectively can you get that back?
sentences.zh: 你有多大能力能把它找回来？

sentences.en: I was going to finish your sentence, without ketamine or some mind-altering drug.
sentences.zh: 我本想接你的话：不用氯胺酮或其他改变心智的药物。

sentences.en: Um, I think you can.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得你可以。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我真的这么认为。

sentences.en: Honestly, just reading those passages made me go, oh, right, right, right, right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 老实说，光是读读那些段落就让我觉得，哦，对，对，对，对，对，对。

sentences.en: That's what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 原来是这么回事。

sentences.en: That's how I can be in the moment and live in the world.
sentences.zh: 这正是我如何能活在当下、生活在世界中的方式。

sentences.en: I've—it's still close enough to my sense of, uh, I can get there.
sentences.zh: 我已经——它离我的感觉还算够近，呃，我能够触及它。

sentences.en: Uh, I think I should challenge myself to do it, um, more, but, uh, even the burden of saying I should challenge myself immediately starts to ruin it with guilt and responsibility.
sentences.zh: 呃，我觉得我应该挑战自己去做到这一点，呃，更多一些，但是，呃，哪怕背负着“我应该挑战自己”这种说法，也会立刻开始被内疚和责任感所毁掉。

sentences.en: And, uh, you know, as she says in the book, no, um, I'm not a raptor.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，正如她在书中所说的那样，不，呃，我不是猛禽。

sentences.en: I'm not a—I'm not ready to spring.
sentences.zh: 我不是——我还没有准备好扑击。

sentences.en: I'm not a jungle cat ready to spring.
sentences.zh: 我不是随时准备扑击的丛林猫。

sentences.en: I'm not—we live in a world that is about achievement.
sentences.zh: 我不是——我们生活在一个崇尚成就的世界里。

sentences.en: You don't want to live without purpose, but all we're about is getting.
sentences.zh: 你固然不能没有目标地生活，但我们所追求的一切都只是索取。

sentences.en: And, you know, it seems to be the only way to feel of value is, um, becoming a millionaire.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，感觉自己有价值的唯一途径似乎就是，呃，成为百万富翁。

sentences.en: So you want to be a millionaire.
sentences.zh: 所以你想成为百万富翁。

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什麽？

sentences.en: Who wants to be a millionaire?
sentences.zh: 谁想成为百万富翁？

sentences.en: Who wants to be a millionaire?
sentences.zh: 谁想成为百万富翁？

sentences.en: Well, I guess everybody, but who wants to be happy?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想每个人都想，但谁想快乐呢？

sentences.en: How about that for a TV show?
sentences.zh: 把这拍成个电视节目怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, in a weird way, it's possible that the path to being a millionaire is clearer than the path to being happy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从某种奇怪的角度来看，通往百万富翁的道路可能比通往快乐的道路更清晰。

sentences.en: Oh, it surely is.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实如此。

sentences.en: It surely is, yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，是的。

sentences.en: And, uh, of course, most people think being a millionaire is what makes you happy.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，当然，大多数人认为成为百万富翁能让你快乐。

sentences.en: But just go talk to a millionaire.
sentences.zh: 但你去跟一个百万富翁谈谈就知道了。

sentences.en: Well, you're a millionaire, I would guess.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我猜你就是一个百万富翁。

sentences.en: Sure, sure.
sentences.zh: 当然，当然。

sentences.en: Did that make you happier?
sentences.zh: 那有让你更快乐吗？

sentences.en: There's no question that the security that you feel from not being afraid of a health issue or, um, what, housing, whatever, you know, is a great comfort and helps you to be more,
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，不再担心健康问题或，呃，住房等问题所带给你的安全感，，你知道，是一种巨大的安慰，能帮助你更加，

sentences.en: uh, at peace with life.
sentences.zh: 呃，与生活达成平和。

sentences.en: There's no question it should help you.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问它应该能帮到你。

sentences.en: It's just not as much help as you think it should be.
sentences.zh: 只是它并没有你想象的那么有用。

sentences.en: I mean, yes, you can eat steak every night, I guess, but then you'd get sick of steak.
sentences.zh: 我是说，是的，你大概可以每天晚上都吃牛排，但接着你就会吃腻牛排。

sentences.en: You know, there, there was a clip of you from an interview that I saw earlier this year that's been kicking around my head since I saw it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，今年早些时候我看到过一个关于你的采访片段，自我看到后就一直在脑子里盘旋。

sentences.en: And it's, uh, you were being interviewed by Mike Berbiglia.
sentences.zh: 那是，呃，迈克·博比利亚在采访你。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And he asks you if there's anyone you're jealous of or something like that.
sentences.zh: 他问你有没有嫉妒过什么人，诸如此类的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the way you answer the question was by saying you're jealous of anyone who has young kids at home.
sentences.zh: 而你回答这个问题的方式是说，你嫉妒任何家里有小孩的人。

sentences.en: Because when you had young kids at home, you had no questions about what your purpose was.
sentences.zh: 因为当你在家里有小孩子的时候，你对自己的生活目标毫无疑问。

sentences.en: You know, it's like your job was to take care of the kids and do dad stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就好像你的工作就是照顾孩子，做做父亲该做的事。

sentences.en: Um, is it the case that you understood that in the moment?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你在当时就明白这一点吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: Or you only understood that in retrospect?
sentences.zh: 还是说你只有在事后才明白？

sentences.en: No, no, I understood it in the moment.
sentences.zh: 不，不，我在当时就明白了。

sentences.en: I absolutely knew this was the best time I'll, I'll ever have in my life.
sentences.zh: 我绝对知道这是我这一生中拥有过的、也将永远拥有的最好时光。

sentences.en: No question.

sentences.en: So, uh, I think when you ask about that, the question, part of the question is, is there a choice?

sentences.zh: 然后我要生活在一个世界里，在这个世界里，我是谁和我如何为人所知之间存在着一点点不和谐？

sentences.en: I get, I get why people go, no, thank you.

sentences.en: I'm going to stay in my littler world where when you know me, I know how you know me.

sentences.zh: 我，我，我不知道我们采访的这一整段，是不是，呃，有点怪。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: Well, it is simply because I've spent the last 15 years doing drama and action and I've, and I've had to think a lot about those things.

sentences.en: So for instance, my friend, David Cross and I are working on a project right now and it's a play.
sentences.zh: 所以举个例子，我和我的朋友大卫·克罗斯现在正在合作一个项目，是一部舞台剧。

sentences.en: I did Glen, Gary, Glen Ross.
sentences.zh: 我演过《拜金一族》。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And while I was doing that play, I was thinking a lot about the mechanics of a play because that play is perfect.
sentences.zh: 在排练那部剧的时候，我一直在思考舞台剧的机制，因为那部剧太完美了。

sentences.en: That play is a machine.
sentences.zh: 那部剧就像一台机器。

sentences.en: It's a machine of drama.
sentences.zh: 一台戏剧的机器。

sentences.en: It's a machine of laughter.
sentences.zh: 一台欢笑的机器。

sentences.en: It's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 简直不可思议。

sentences.en: It's tight as can be.
sentences.zh: 严丝合缝到了极点。

sentences.en: And so just being a part of it, thinking about it, I started to see, you know, some of the,
sentences.zh: 所以身处其中、去思考它的时候，我开始看出，你知道的，其中的一些，

sentences.en: you could say the mechanics of it and think about how great they were and how maybe I could try to steal some of those, you know,
sentences.zh: 可以说它的机制，去思考它们有多么伟大，以及或许我可以试着借鉴其中的一些，你知道的，

sentences.en: and make something too in that world that might have some value and might work.
sentences.zh: 也在那个世界里创作出一些东西，可能具有某种价值，也行得通。

sentences.en: It's similar to when I was at Saturday Night Live for four years and I didn't help all that much.
sentences.zh: 这有点像我当年在《周六夜现场》待了四年的时候，其实我没帮上太多忙。

sentences.en: I pitched some jokes that Robert Smigel would use.
sentences.zh: 我提过一些罗伯特·斯米格尔会用的笑话。

sentences.en: Occasionally I had a sketch that would get on.
sentences.zh: 偶尔我有一个小品能被采纳。

sentences.en: But basically I sat around listening to Al Franken and Jim Downey and Robert Smigel and Conan O'Brien and Jack Handy and Bonnie and Terry Turner.
sentences.zh: 但基本上我就是坐在旁边听艾尔·弗兰肯、吉姆·唐尼、罗伯特·斯米格尔、柯南·奥布莱恩、杰克·汉迪、邦妮和特里·特纳聊天。

sentences.en: And I watched these people write great sketches and my brain went, oh, I see what they did.
sentences.zh: 我看着这些人写出棒极了的小品，我的大脑就想：哦，我懂他们是怎么做的了。

sentences.en: Oh, I see what you did.
sentences.zh: 哦，我懂你们是怎么弄的了。

sentences.en: And it kind of deconstructed it.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是一种解构。

sentences.en: And then I used it to make Mr. Show.
sentences.zh: 然后我用它来创作了《守望先锋》（译者注：此处应指Mr. Show，保持直译或意译，根据上下文）。

sentences.en: So, so David and I are writing a play and we'll see if we get there, but you know, our, our great desire to make it is make it, it's kind of got sketch comedy in it,
sentences.zh: 所以，所以大卫和我在写一个剧本，我们会看看能不能写成，你知道的，我们内心极大的渴望是把它做成，里面有点小品喜剧的元素，

sentences.en: but it's not a sketch.
sentences.zh: 但它又不是一个小品。

sentences.en: It's, it's something more hopefully.
sentences.zh: 希望它能成为某种更深刻的东西。

sentences.en: And, but we want to, we want to make it a sketch because it's too fun and sketches are over in five minutes and they're done and you get to move on to the next idea.
sentences.zh: 但是我们又想把它做成小品的感觉，因为那太有趣了，而且小品五分钟就结束了，然后你就完成了，可以进入下一个创意。

sentences.en: Um,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: so I still, I, I, I still have an instinct for it, but I, I now, I do feel what I've said is true that doing sketch comedy when you get older is a little strange.
sentences.zh: 所以我依然，我，我，我依然对它有着直觉，但我现在，我的确觉得我之前说过的是真的，年纪大了之后再去演小品喜剧感觉有点怪怪的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: It's a little like, it's like a young person's energy is right for it.
sentences.zh: 这有点像，就像年轻人的精力才适合它。

sentences.en: It fits.
sentences.zh: 很契合。

sentences.en: And when you get older, it's like, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 而当你上了年纪，就会觉得：你在干什么？

sentences.en: What are you doing being so silly?
sentences.zh: 你这么幼稚到底在干什么？

sentences.en: And what are you doing being so, it becomes, um, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你这么，这变得，嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: And it loses something.
sentences.zh: 而且它失去了一些东西。

sentences.en: So what's comedy that speaks to you now where you are in your life?
sentences.zh: 那么，现在到了你人生的这个阶段，能触动你的喜剧是什么样的？

sentences.en: Oh boy.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Um, the, honestly, the comedy that speaks to me most right now is a thing called On Cinema.
sentences.zh: 嗯，老实说，现在最能触动我的喜剧是一个叫《关于电影》（On Cinema）的东西。

sentences.en: It's a pretend, um, movie review show that is on, uh, the internet by my friend Tim Heidecker.
sentences.zh: 那是由我的朋友蒂姆·海德克在互联网上制作的一个假装的，嗯，电影评论节目。

sentences.en: And it's, again, you know, for me, sketch comedy, and this is kind of a sketch comic thing, but it's drawn out and slowed down.
sentences.zh: 而且，对我来说，小品喜剧——这算是某种小品喜剧的东西，但它被拉长和放慢了。

sentences.en: And I think sketch comedy, I'm sorry to say it, is the most profound expression of human, uh, existence there is.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为小品喜剧，很抱歉这么说，是人类，嗯，存在的最深刻的表达方式。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: I don't think any Kubrick movie or Freudian analysis or Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 我不认为任何库布里克的电影、弗洛伊德的分析或莎士比亚的作品。

sentences.en: Shakespeare or Shakespeare says as much about how humans operate and what is the ultimate problem with us as a species than sketch comedy.
sentences.zh: 莎士比亚，或是莎士比亚，关于人类如何运作以及我们作为一个物种的终极问题，其阐述都不及小品喜剧深刻。

sentences.en: And I wish it was not true.
sentences.zh: 我希望这不是真的。

sentences.en: I wish the drama, grand drama.
sentences.zh: 我希望剧情，宏大的剧情。

sentences.en: I wish that we were worthy of being taken apart and, and, and, and are, and, and observed in subtle and complex ways.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们配得上被剖析，被，被，被，以及被以微妙而复杂的方式观察。

sentences.en: But I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 但我并不这么认为。

sentences.en: I think that ultimately there is nothing more profound about people than you can say in a sketch.
sentences.zh: 我认为归根结底，关于人类，没有什么是比你在一个小品里所能表达的更深刻的了。

sentences.en: They're fucking idiots.
sentences.zh: 他们就是一群他妈的白痴。

sentences.en: People are sadly limited, so limited that you can, you can define them and you can share everything that's important about them in four minutes.
sentences.zh: 人类可悲地有着局限性，局限到你甚至可以，可以定义他们，并且在四分钟内分享完关于他们的一切重要事情。

sentences.en: Wait, maybe this is related.
sentences.zh: 等等，也许这有关系。

sentences.en: Maybe this is related.
sentences.zh: 也许这有关系。

sentences.zh: 嗯，就在你回忆录的结尾附近，你写道，嗯，你知道，演艺界并不是在治愈癌症，它只是一种消遣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And, and the way you put it is, which is inarguably key to life on earth.
sentences.zh: 而且，你表达的方式是，这无疑是地球上生活之关键。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because life on earth is so bleak and painful.
sentences.zh: 因为地球上的生活是如此惨淡和痛苦。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And the only and best response to that is to look away.
sentences.zh: 而对此唯一也是最好的回应就是移开视线。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Um, you want me to repudiate that statement?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你是想让我收回这种说法吗？

sentences.zh: 我一直在想，你写下这句话时是不是在讽刺，因为它给我的感觉很惨淡，相当惨淡。

sentences.en: Too sad.
sentences.zh: 太悲伤了。

sentences.en: I don't know what to say, man.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该说什么，老兄。

sentences.en: Pretty much do think that's true, but I do think that, obviously, I think there's joy and reward in being alive and, and, and, in, uh, in the ways in which we look away.
sentences.zh: 我确实基本上认为那是真的，但我确实认为，显然，我认为活着是有快乐和回报的，而且，在，在，在，在，在，在，在那些我们移开视线的方式中。

sentences.en: In whatever way in which you find to transform, uh, that, um, horror, the horror, the horror.
sentences.zh: 无论你用什么方式去转化，嗯，那种恐惧，那恐惧，那恐惧。

sentences.en: In whatever way you find to transform that into something good, entertaining, beautiful, uh, comforting to another person, helpful, that is, that's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 无论你用什么方式把那转化为美好的、娱乐性的、美丽的、嗯，能安慰他人、有帮助的东西，那是，那是美好的。

sentences.en: Comedy gold.

sentences.en: Well, whatever gold you can make it into, whatever kind of alchemy you can do is, I guess, to me, that's, that's the good part.
sentences.zh: 好吧，无论你能把它变成什么黄金，无论你能进行什么样的点金术，我想对我来说，那就是，那就是精彩的部分。

sentences.zh: 现在，小孩子们，如果我们想回到你的起点的话。

sentences.en: Yes, that's what I was going to do, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，我正要这么做，对。

sentences.zh: 他们是通过活着来做到这一点的，孩子们通过活着，通过，通过看着他们活着来做到这一点。

sentences.en: You, I think you feel that, that magic, that when you come to fully grasp life, and, uh, it can be, uh, taken away from you, uh, bit by bit until it's all gone.
sentences.zh: 你，我想你能感受到，那种魔法，当你开始完全领悟生活时，而，嗯，它可能会，嗯，被一点一点从你身边剥夺，直到全部消失。

sentences.en: But you can reconnect with it, and, uh, yeah, I, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但你可以重新与它建立联系，而且，嗯，是的，我，我不知道。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这次采访的挑战之一是，我对自我没有一个统一的场论。

sentences.en: I'm a bit of, um, as you can see from my career, I kind of go in a lot of directions.
sentences.zh: 我有点像，嗯，正如你从我的职业生涯中所看到的，我有点向很多方向发展。

sentences.en: And I don't have a very, um, solid justification for, uh, the, uh, the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 而且我对于，嗯，这整个事情，并没有一个非常，嗯，坚实的正当理由。

sentences.en: I can't characterize the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我无法概括这整件事。

sentences.en: I, and my, and the only thing I, I can say is that there's a risk, there's a great risk that I am willing to take, I think, because I don't think much of myself.
sentences.zh: 我，而且我能说的唯一一件事是，这里面有一个风险，一个我愿意承担的巨大风险，我想，因为我对自己的评价不高。

sentences.zh: 换句话说，比方说我在尝试拍动作片时出了个大丑。

sentences.en: Well, so what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.en: So what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我还是可以演喜剧，然后设法东山再起吧我想。

sentences.en: We should end on that note.
sentences.zh: 我们应该以这个调子结束。

sentences.zh: 是的，但我，我希望我没有出丑。

sentences.zh: 我，我认为对我来说更大的问题是，我现在该做什么？

sentences.en: Because, um, well, I guess I have, I just do what I've always done.
sentences.zh: 因为，嗯，好吧，我想我有了，我只是做我一直以来都在做的事。

sentences.en: Look for the next thing, uh, that, that seems curious, worthwhile, surprising.
sentences.zh: 寻找下一件，嗯，看起来好奇的、值得的、令人惊讶的事情。

sentences.en: I'll, I'll, I'll find a hard time beating, uh, action movies.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我发现要超越，嗯，动作片会很难。

sentences.zh: 我跟你直说吧。

sentences.zh: 我很难找到任何我可以追求的东西，能像那种类型的电影那样，离我最初的起点那么远。
